description: Heavy blacksmith's workbench, 2.0 m long, 0.7 m deep, top at 0.86 m: two thick rough oak planks on four stout square legs with aprons, low stretchers and a back shelf board; burn marks and soot on the top. A leg (post) vise on the front left corner: iron leg to the floor, jaws just above the top, screw with a tommy bar. Stands with its back to a wall.
